task.description: Design Wasm module execution engine. Produce design artefact covering: Wasmtime integration architecture, module ABI contract, source compilation job design, compile caching strategy, import whitelist enforcement, resource limits (fuel/memory/timeout), host API parity with Lua, instance pooling strategy, and hot reload mechanism. Design must cover all 14 WASM-* requirements.
acceptance_criteria: All 14 requirement IDs cross-referenced in design
Module interfaces, data structures, and state machine documented
Wasmtime configuration and sandboxing strategy documented

result.summary: Comprehensive Wasm module execution design covering all 14 WASM requirements: Wasmtime static linking, module ABI contract (init/execute/deinit/get_capabilities exports), source compilation job design with caching and reproducibility, capability sandboxing with import whitelist and filesystem restrictions, memory isolation with pointer validation, fuel-based instruction counting, memory caps, wall-clock timeout enforcement, host API parity with Lua (variable read/write, service calls, logging, time source, UUID generation, structured failure), instance pooling with per-invocation memory reset, hot reload with version management and in-flight invocation isolation.
